name: ai-model-vault
description: MCP tool manifest for AI Model Vault — encrypted AI/ML model management with versioning, conversion, compliance, and RAG.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search the RAG knowledge base using vector similarity (cosine distance). Returns ranked documents matching the query embedding.

query.description: The search query text to find similar documents

top_k.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

tools.name: add_document
tools.description: Add a document to the RAG knowledge base. Documents are stored with optional metadata and embeddings for similarity search.

tools.name: chunk_text
tools.description: Split text into overlapping chunks for RAG ingestion. Uses configurable chunk size and overlap.

text.description: The text to split into chunks

overlap.description: Overlap between adjacent chunks in characters (default: 50)

tools.name: execute_rule
tools.description: Execute a business rule from the rule engine against a given context. Rules have conditions and actions executed by priority.

rule_id.description: ID of the rule to execute

context.description: Key-value context for rule condition evaluation

tools.name: vault_init
tools.description: Initialize a new encrypted vault for storing AI models. Creates XDG-compliant directory structure with AES-256-GCM encryption.

name.description: Name of the vault to create (default: 'default')

tools.name: vault_store
tools.description: Store an AI model in the vault with encryption, versioning, and metadata. Supports 23+ model formats.

name.description: Name to store the model under

path.description: File path to the model to store

parent_version.description: Parent version number for lineage tracking

tools.name: vault_get
tools.description: Retrieve and decrypt a model from the vault. Verifies SHA-256 checksum on retrieval.

name.description: Name of the model to retrieve

output.description: Output file path for the decrypted model

tools.name: vault_list
tools.description: List all models stored in the vault with their versions, formats, and sizes.

tools.name: vault_versions
tools.description: List all versions of a specific model with timestamps, sizes, and parent lineage.

name.description: Model name to list versions for

tools.name: vault_lineage
tools.description: Show the version ancestry tree for a model version, tracing parent-child relationships.

version.description: Version number to trace lineage from

tools.name: model_convert
tools.description: Convert a model between formats. Supports PyTorch→SafeTensors/ONNX/TorchScript/CoreML/MLX, SafeTensors→GGUF, ONNX→TensorRT/OpenVINO/TFLite, TensorFlow→TFLite.

model.description: Name of the model to convert

tools.name: compliance_check
tools.description: Run FIPS 140-3, CMMC 2.0, and MITRE ATT&CK compliance checks against the vault configuration.

tools.name: cloud_push
tools.description: Push an encrypted model to cloud storage (AWS S3, Azure Blob, or Google Cloud Storage).

tools.name: cloud_pull
tools.description: Pull an encrypted model from cloud storage into the local vault.

tools.name: model_analyze
tools.description: Analyze a stored model — size, compression ratio, format details, parameter estimates.

tools.name: model_deduplicate
tools.description: Find duplicate models in the vault using SHA-256 hash comparison.

tools.name: vault_stats
tools.description: Get vault statistics — total models, versions, storage used, format distribution.

tools.name: database_search
tools.description: Full-text search across the RAG database (SQLite or Sled backend).

resources.name: Vault Models
resources.description: List of all models in the current vault with versions and metadata

resources.name: Vault Statistics
resources.description: Aggregate statistics about vault contents, storage, and formats

resources.name: Compliance Report
resources.description: FIPS/CMMC/MITRE compliance status for the current vault

resources.name: Model Card
resources.description: Model card documentation for a specific model

resources.name: Model Versions
resources.description: Version history and lineage for a specific model

resources.name: RAG Documents
resources.description: List of documents in the RAG knowledge base

resources.name: Conversion Paths
resources.description: Supported format conversion paths and quantization schemes

prompts.name: store_model
prompts.description: Guide storing a new AI model in the vault with proper metadata

prompts.name: convert_model
prompts.description: Guide converting a model between formats with optimal settings

prompts.name: compliance_audit
prompts.description: Run a full compliance audit and explain results

prompts.name: setup_rag
prompts.description: Guide setting up a RAG knowledge base with documents
